issues.current_text: Na fronteira biológica, a Olatec Therapeutics dosou os primeiros pacientes com Parkinson
issues.previous_text: Na fronteira biológica, a Celosia Therapeutics dosou o primeiro paciente com ELA
issues.suggestion: Identical transition phrase 'Na fronteira biológica' and nearly identical sentence structure 'dosou o(s) primeiro(s) paciente(s) com [doença]' used two days in a row. Rewrite the transition — e.g. 'Em ensaios clínicos' or 'No campo farmacêutico' — and vary the sentence structure so the lead-in doesn't mirror yesterday's edition.

summary: Moderate repetition: identical 'Na fronteira biológica' + 'dosou primeiro(s) paciente(s)' phrasing from yesterday, Amazon robotics acquisition pattern within 3 days, and Iran/Hormuz + drone-military blocks appearing in all four consecutive editions with similar structural packaging.
